items.headline: Anthropic releases Claude Opus 4.5
items.summary: Anthropic says Claude Opus 4.5 is state of the art on SWE-bench Verified and adds an effort parameter for trading speed and cost against capability. Pricing is $5/$25 per million input/output tokens, well below earlier Opus models, and it is available in the API and on the three major cloud platforms.
